title: Prime Minister congratulates Prince Noble and Manu Francis on winning Silver in Men’s Skiff at Asian Games 2026
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated Prince Noble and Manu Francis on winning the Silver medal in the Men’s Skiff event at the Asian Games 2026.
The Prime Minister said that the duo bettered their previous performances and reached the podium, describing it as a remarkable leap powered by skill and determination.
Shri Modi extended his best wishes to Prince Noble and Manu Francis for their future endeavours.
The Prime Minister’s Office wrote said in X post;
“A special and spectacular Silver!
Congrats to Prince Noble and Manu Francis on winning the Silver Medal in the Men’s Skiff event at the Asian Games 2026.
They bettered their previous performances and did well by reaching the podium this time. It has truly been a remarkable leap powered by skill and determination. Best wishes for their endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi”
